_comment: Baked into the RunPod worker image/env for the monthly retest (spec 5).
The daily on-droplet run does not use this file at all - it calls
solopt.pipeline directly. Do NOT put droplet_token here if this file
might end up in a container image - set SOLOPT_TOKEN in the environment
Generate the token from the dashboard: Settings -> RunPod worker token.
_utilization_comment: A fixed cap on how much of the machine the search may use, as a percentage
of wall-clock time. 60 leaves the PC responsive for other work; 100 runs
flat out. This is a duty cycle, not a thermal governor - it does what it
says regardless of what the GPU temperature is doing.

walk_forward._thresholds_comment: A window needs 30 closed trades to count; 70% of counted windows must be profitable; a set whose window returns vary more than they average is flagged overfit.
walk_forward._search_comment: The search stops at the cap or early once the best result stops improving for plateau_rounds batches.
walk_forward._churn_comment: Sets that trade above this rate are discounted. The prior configuration ran at roughly 35 a day and paid 449 USD in fees for it.

_grid_comment: Omit 'grid' entirely to use solopt.params.DEFAULT_GRID. Keep it coarse:
a fine grid over sixteen axes is a curve-fitting machine, and the
walk-forward windows are what earn the right to narrow it later.
